feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. This candidate is the verified iteration 9 platform (271.06) with the iteration 9 controller, so it reproduces the best evidence you have. The evidence for each element: iteration 9 gave 8 of 20 oval completions with ±0.03 m outer sensors, 15 mm spacing, y = 0.04 and a 0.016 footprint. Iteration 8 reproduced iteration 7 exactly, so the result is deterministic. Iteration 10 showed wheel_track 0.14 lowered oval completions to 3 of 20 and the score to 215.32. Iteration 6 showed the ±0.036 reach at kd 0.25 scored 97.7, and iterations 2 and 3 showed that body changes cost s-bend progress. Because this is the final iteration, no further race will follow this one, so the requested changes below are for the record and do not alter this race.
requested_changes: Keep sensor_positions at x = ±0.03 and y = 0.04 with 15 mm spacing, and sensor_size 0.016. Evidence: iteration 9 (271.06, 8 of 20 oval completions) and iteration 8 reproducing iteration 7 exactly.
Keep wheel_track at 0.12. Evidence: iteration 10 at wheel_track 0.14 dropped oval completions from 8 to 3 and the score from 271.06 to 215.32.
Keep body_length 0.18, body_width 0.12 and mass 0.8. Evidence: iteration 2 (0.14 m, 0.6 kg) cut s-bend progress from 0.16 to 0.1275, and iteration 3 recovered it on the baseline body.
